title: PARALLAX / DREAMSTATE V4 dependence-aware robustness on verified live main
summary: Reconciles PARALLAX / DREAMSTATE V4 onto the latest ICARUS main after the unrelated Windows Psi evidence fix. V4 adds episode-aware effective sample size, Newey-West/HAC dependence-adjusted inference, and cross-revision contradiction/transportability diagnostics while preserving V3 temporal and parameter-basin robustness. DREAMSTATE carries the same evidence into policy contracts, Brain mirrors, search accounting, refresh, and live source revalidation. All authority remains research/shadow only.
